Name: Fruit Trees Reforged
Author: Larvuk
Description:
This mod adds several features making Fruit Trees more worth the investment, and more balanced with normal crops.
No AI involved.

[b][size=5]R[/size][/b][b][size=5]ebalance of the number of fruits produced each day by trees[/size][/b]

When you plant cranberry seeds, you expect to harvest many of them. That's what make them interesting even if a single pumpkin is more expensive than a single cranberry.
Just the same way you can expect a cherry tree to produce loads of cherries.

With this mod many trees will produce more than one fruit per day.

Maximum number of fruits on trees is globally raised so you still don't have to harvest them every day.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/3936]This page details all behaviors of supported trees.[/url]


[size=5][b]Rebalance of the tree fruits themselves[/b][/size]

Make tree fruit artisan products not just to give them to raccoons!

As they are more numerous and/or expensive, make jelly, wine or dried fruits from your tree fruits and earn money. That's why you planted them right?


[b][size=5]New Sapling Incubator machine[/size][/b]

Did you ever try to put a tree fruit in your seed maker? Yes you did. I saw you. I was hiding under your bed.

This mod adds a new machine that makes a tree fruit seed and some potting soil into a healthy sapling ready to be planted on your farm. It takes time and resources so it's not unbalancing the game.

So try again with your tree fruit and your seed maker. Don't worry, I'll be here watching.


[b][size=5]New Fruit Tree Fertilizer[/size][/b]

Speed up the growth of your trees with this new product.

Nothing more to say. It's a marvel. Just a little bit painful to craft.[b]


[size=5]Modded trees compatibility[/size]

Includes[/b] incubator-compatibility and rebalance of fruit trees from:[b]
- Stardew Valley Expanded
- Cornucopia - more Crops[/b] (with alternative versions for Eucalyptus Tree and Walnut Tree)[b]﻿
[b]- Cornucopia - more Flowers[/b][/b]
[b]- Cornucopia - Growable Forage[/b]
[b]- Ridgeside Village[/b][b]
- Visit Mount Vapius
-﻿ Wildflour’s Artisan Goods
- Nando's Artisan Goods[/b]
[b]- Kalash More Fruit Trees[/b]
[b]- Sunberry Village + Rose and the Alchemist[/b]
[b]- Night Market Expansion
[/b]
Not supposed to break anything if you're using unsupported modded trees.
The fertilizer will still work on them. They will normally produce one fruit per day and be able to bear 10 fruits before harvesting.
Please contact me if you're having issues with any modded tree.[b]


[size=5]Configuration[/size]

[/b]Each feature can be deactivated via [b]GMCM.
[/b]Rebalance can be deactivated separately for Vanilla and each supported extension.
Several options let you choose the level of difficulty you want, so check the config.


[size=5][b]Default configuration you might want to deactivate (please read this part)[/b][/size]

[b][i]Fruit trees planted in your greenhouse will only give 40% of their normal production.[/i][/b] This is a standard behaviour when using Advanced Fruit Tree Framework (AFTF) that is a requirement for this mod. But you can raise it back in the GMCM options panel, in the AFTF page.

[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]

Unzip in your mod folder. Don't forget the dependencies.
It seems to work fine on existing saves. 


[b][size=5]Translations[/size][/b]

The mod supports the following languages:
[b]-English (by me)[/b] /!\ a quick check by a native english speaker would be great![b]
-French (by me)
-Spanish (by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Hayato2236]Hayato2236[/url])
-German (by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Kurila]Kurila[/url])
-Chinese (by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/﻿Glacier0w0]Glacier0w0[/url]) [/b]/!\ incomplete translation - help us![b]
-Italian (by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/tegustopesca]tegustopesca[/url])[/b]
[b]-Russian (by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Erayd]Erayd[/url]) freshly added in 2.0![/b]


If you want to help with your native language please send me a message.


[size=5][b]Global compatibility[/b][/size]

Made for [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.[/b]

[b]Bonster Crops' trees are not supported[/b] because they're [b]insanely numerous[/b].

Compatibility with other mods using AFTF is guaranteed.
Compatibility with other mods affecting fruit trees and not using AFTF is probably impossible.

Uses Harmony, and impacts the following methods (there might be conflicts with mods impacting the same methods):[font=Courier New]
Object.placementAction()
Object.canBePlacedHere()[/font]
